QuestInfo.name: An Arcforger in My Own Right!
QuestInfo.0: It seems the Arcforging master #p602# of #m10005000# is finally ready to recognize my Arcforging skills.
QuestInfo.1: The Arcforging master, #p602# of #m10005000#, was impressed with my growth and challenged me to prove my skill. I need to defeat #r#o19#s#k and craft #b1 #t4020106##k to bring back to him.
QuestInfo.2: Amazed by my craftsmanship, the Arcforging master #p602# of #m10005000# handed me a #t4130003#. It appears to be a special item that can be used during crafting to create even stronger scrolls. Should I give it a try?

0.0: I have heard whispers here in #m10005000# that you have become a true Arcforger. It stirred my curiosity, and now I wish to see the truth with my own eyes. I see honesty in them... but, can you prove your mastery to me?

yes.0: Excellent—your spirit remains passionate as ever. Go to the outskirts of #m10005000#, defeat #r#o19#s#k, and craft #b1 #t4020106##k to bring back to me. I shall wait here.

no.0: Ah... It seems your mind is not yet prepared.

1.0: Now then... let me see. Ho... This #t4020106# is crafted with remarkable precision and beauty. In some ways, it may even surpass my own work. You have earned my admiration, so I must give you a gift worthy of your achievement.

yes.0: This #t4130003# is a special item. When used in the making of scrolls, it can produce scrolls far more powerful than ordinary ones. But be warned: such power is unstable--while the effects grow stronger, the chance of success falls. A path of risk and reward.
yes.1: If you wish to test the limits of your Arcforging skill, I encourage you to use it. Continue your training with dedication, and your wisdom will deepen.

mob.0: It appears you did not defeat all the monsters I spoke of. Perhaps your training is still lacking...

item.0: It seems you do not have the material I requested. Perhaps your training is still lacking...
